text.en: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) the top 2 cards of your Deck. You can only use each of the following effects of "Xenovader△ of Sky Sheol" once per turn. If this card is in your hand and you control a "Xenovader△" monster: You can Special Summon this card. During your Main Phase: You can add up to 2 of your face-down banished "Xenovader△" Spells/Traps with different names to your hand, also you cannot activate cards or effects for the rest of this turn, except "Xenovader△" cards or effects.
